title: The Lethal Maya Ballgame
hook: Athletes bounced a 9-pound solid rubber ball with hips and knees.

scenes.text: Long before European sports existed, ancient Mesoamericans played 'pok-a-tok': a high-stakes, spiritual ballgame.
scenes.imagePrompt: Massive stone ballcourt at Chichen Itza with sloping stone aprons, temple platforms, and high parallel limestone walls. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Long before European sports existed, ancient Mesoamericans played 'pok-a-tok': a high-stakes, spiritual ballgame.

scenes.text: The ball was solid tree latex rubber weighing up to nine pounds—so dense and heavy that hitting it wrong shattered ribs and fractured skulls.
scenes.imagePrompt: Heavy solid black rubber game ball resting on carved limestone court paving beside a leather protective waist yoke. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: The ball was solid tree latex rubber weighing up to nine pounds—so dense and heavy that hitting it wrong shattered ribs and fractured skulls.

scenes.text: Players were strictly forbidden from using hands or feet; they could only strike the heavy rubber with padded hips, elbows, and knees.
scenes.imagePrompt: Carved wooden and leather hip yoke armor adorned with jade stone ornaments resting on a stone bench in sunlight. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Players were strictly forbidden from using hands or feet; they could only strike the heavy rubber with padded hips, elbows, and knees.

scenes.text: To win, players had to propel the bouncing ball through vertical stone scoring hoops mounted twenty-five feet high on court walls.

scenes.text: Matches simulated cosmic battles between the sun and underworld gods; on sacred occasions, the losing team captain was sacrificed.
